title: ui live e2e: read-only-member-record counts the record page's read (POST /data/:object/:id/page) as a write, so the nightly live tier is red
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a named, reproduced defect, here a test that reads a read as a write. It was measured on PR #28613's own nightly-tiers run, and it is not that PR's: it only reshuffles shards.
Business reason: the nightly `live` tier is the only place the Console live specs run outside the required job (`examples/app-showcase/test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts`). While this spec fails, that tier stays red on `main`, and the red card it files (#28580's channel) hides any real regression behind a known one.
Reader: the `domain:ui` lane, the next PR on `ui/e2e/live/`. Until #28613 lands, the nightly's shard 1 is killed by its 45-minute timeout before this spec runs. Once it lands, this is the next red the card reports.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "read-only-member-record" → 9 hits (#27552, closed, is the card that added the spec; none reports this), "attempted no write" → 17 hits, none on this spec, "/page write detector" → 0 hits.
reach: measured, nightly `live` tier, run 41286811251 job 124789667673 (`Nightly tiers (4/4)` on PR #28613 head `a9fdb19a1d`), 2026-11-01T08:04Z.
QA-source: none (CI nightly tier)
type: Bug

## Reading (verbatim)

```
1) [chromium] › e2e/live/read-only-member-record.spec.ts:44:1 › a member who may read but not write an inquiry gets a read-only form and no edit affordance; the admin edits it
   Error: the member browser attempted no write
   - Array []
   + Array [
   +   "POST http://localhost:41835/api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry/H0mCRgRpfpwhhwLC/page",
   +   "POST http://localhost:41835/api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry/H0mCRgRpfpwhhwLC/page",
   + ]
   > 107 |       expect(writes, 'the member browser attempted no write').toEqual([]);
```

## Cause

- The spec's write detector (`ui/e2e/live/read-only-member-record.spec.ts`, near line 28) records every non-`GET` request under `/api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry` as a write.
- `POST /api/v1/data/:object/:id/page` is a read. It returns the record page payload (#27627; `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`, `client: 'data.recordPage'`), and the record page now loads through it (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, `data.recordPage`).
- So the member's own page load is counted as two writes.

## Expected

The detector excludes the record-page read (`POST …/:id/page`). The safest form names the write routes it means: `POST` to the collection, `PATCH` / `PUT` / `DELETE` on a record, and the batch and action routes. That way a future read-shaped `POST` cannot red it again. The assertion that the member sends no write stays. The spec still fails if the member's browser really writes.
